description: Smarte Strasse: Aufrufe der Microsites is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Statistisches Amt. Im Rahmen des Projekts «Smarte Strasse» wurden Sensoren an verschiedenen Standorten angebracht. Um die Transparenz zu erhöhen, werden im Projekt «Smarte Strasse» die Sensoren sowie die Daten, die damit erfasst werden, vor Ort mit Piktogrammen und QR-Codes leicht verständlich sichtbar gemacht. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Territory and environment. Its keywords are QR-Codes, Tracking, Seitenaufrufe. The portal shows 1,025 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-02-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
